actions.reason: The K7_C0004-K7_C0007 boundary is weak and merge-compatible. Structural diagnostics show only a partially represented two-way assignment (independent two-way spectral ARI 0.630) with a high normalized-cut cost (0.620), indicating material cross-boundary connectivity and weak graph support for preserving the boundary, and the union eigengap is dominated by the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1), which is merge-compatible and must not be read as support for preserving two units. Although affinity geometry concordance is directionally positive across modalities, it is only moderate/weak and does not establish affirmative boundary evidence. Biologically the two sets are not mutually exclusive: K7_C0004 shows no driver-panel mutation signal surviving correction (all q_driver=1.0), and K7_C0007 likewise shows no corrected driver-panel signal with only nominal PBRM1/VHL trends, so neither side carries a distinct coherent molecular identity that would oppose union. The union is therefore more consistent with a single unit than with two independently retained sets.
